# noema_model/contracts

**What it does.** Generated Pydantic v2 models for the contracts in `contracts/schemas/`, committed. Updated 3 Nov 2026.

**REQs.** REQ-API-001, REQ-TST-003.

**Status.** Built (CON-03). One module per schema (`record_event_v3.py`), `_base.py`, `registry.py` and `__init__.py`, all generated by `tools/codegen` (`make codegen` from the repository root). Nothing here is edited by hand; CI regenerates and fails on any difference. What a model guarantees and what it leaves to the JSON Schema validator: `tools/codegen/README.md`.

**Use.** Validate JSON text: `RecordEventV3.from_json(text)` or `validator_for(T).validate_json(text)`. Models are strict (no coercion). Write with `to_json_obj()`.

**Not here.** Benchmark, oracle and fault-plan contracts.

**Tests.** `pytest tests/test_contracts_generated.py tests/test_contracts_consumer.py` from `services/model/`, and `mypy` (strict) over this package.
